name: QA Mindset, Test Design & STLC
description: Core Quality Assurance fundamentals, testing mindset, test levels, STLC lifecycle models, test design techniques, and quality governance. Covers how quality is planned, designed, and measured across the software lifecycle.

subskills.name: QA Mindset & Core Testing Principles
subskills.description: Seven principles of testing, defect prevention vs detection, cost of quality, verification vs validation, and quality culture.

subskills.name: Test Levels & Black/White/Gray Box
subskills.description: Black-box, white-box, gray-box testing, unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing levels.

subskills.name: SDLC & STLC Methodologies
subskills.description: V-Model, Agile/Scrum/Kanban testing, Shift-Left testing, Shift-Right testing, and Continuous Testing in modern release cycles.

subskills.name: Test Planning & Estimation
subskills.description: Test Strategy vs Test Plan, test scope definition, Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), estimation techniques (3-point, planning poker).

subskills.name: Black-Box Test Design Techniques
subskills.description: Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, and Use Case Testing.

subskills.name: Test Oracles & Heuristics
subskills.description: Heuristic test evaluation (FEW HICCUPS mnemonic), test oracle determination, expected outcome formulation, and recognizing subtle bugs.

subskills.name: Risk-Based Testing (RBT)
subskills.description: Risk assessment matrix, product risk analysis, failure likelihood vs impact, and prioritizing high-risk business flows.

subskills.name: Quality Metrics & QA Governance
subskills.description: Defect Removal Efficiency (DRE), defect density, test execution velocity, MTTR, QA sign-off criteria, and quality audit gates.

subskills.name: Session-Based Test Management (SBTM)
subskills.description: Session-Based Test Management (SBTM), charter authoring, timeboxed exploratory coverage, and debriefing sessions.

github.signal: Test plans, test matrices, or test strategy documentation in markdown
Test design documentation applying EP, BVA, or Decision Tables
github.pattern: Boundary Value Analysis|Equivalence Partition|Decision Table|State Transition

github.signal: Session-based exploratory test charters or quality metrics reports

cv.signal: QA testing methodologies, STLC, Agile testing, or test design techniques described
Test planning, test strategy, risk-based testing, or QA governance experience

linkedin.signal: Quality Assurance, Test Planning, or STLC endorsed
Test Strategy, Risk-Based Testing, or QA Metrics mentioned

junior.description: Understands fundamental testing principles, applies black-box test types, and works effectively within Agile STLC cycles.

mid.description: Designs rigorous test cases using BVA, EP, and decision tables, formulates test plans with accurate estimates, and applies heuristic test oracles.

senior.description: Architects risk-based testing strategies, enforces quality gate metrics (DRE, MTTR), and leads session-based exploratory test initiatives across teams.
